Routes 126-128 and every Mossdeep Gym room therefore sit at cap 76. Rillaboom gate 36 (Grookey, Mauville Game Corner; level evolutions). Urshifu-Single-Strike gate 42 (Kubfu legendary_sign Route112, the Jagged Pass approach used for the Magma Emblem). Gardevoir gate 30 (Ralts Route102 land) with ITEM_GARDEVOIRITE stone-window 14. Zapdos gate 30, legendary_sign NewMauville_Inside. Amoonguss gate 42 (Foongus, Petalburg Woods). Nothing is sourced from Mossdeep, the Space Center, Route 127-128, Shoal Cave, the Abandoned Ship, Seafloor Cavern, Sootopolis, Pacifidlog or Route 131 - a player who has just sailed east out of Lilycove has reached none of those.
plan: Generalist doubles core for the eastern sea routes. Incineroar and Rillaboom both carry Fake Out so the first turn is always controllable, Intimidate blunts the physical Water lanes, Grassy Surge gives Grassy Glide priority and heals through chip. Zapdos is the Electric pressure every Water route trainer invites. Urshifu-Single's Unseen Fist punches through the heavy Protect habit of this stretch. Mega Gardevoir's Pixilate Hyper Voice is the spread that ignores Rage Powder and answers the Dark lane.
